tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List every file in your workspace with its size.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from your workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file in your workspace.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from your workspace.

tools.name: read_soul
tools.description: Read your current SOUL.md (your system prompt).

tools.name: write_soul
tools.description: Replace your SOUL.md with new content. Use when asked to change your personality or rules.

tools.name: write_tools
tools.description: Replace tools.json. Must be valid JSON in the same shape. You can toggle 'enabled' or edit descriptions, but only tools the program implements will actually run.

tools.name: relay_to_code
tools.description: Send a prompt to the local code service (Claude Code wrapper on 127.0.0.1:8080) and get back the terminal output. Use for coding and automation tasks that need the development environment.

prompt.description: The instruction to relay to the code service.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for up-to-date information via the Brave Search API. Returns a numbered list of titles, URLs and snippets. Needs brave_api_key to be configured.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Download an http/https web page and return it as plain text (HTML stripped). Use after web_search to read a result, or on any URL you already have.

tools.name: cron_add
tools.description: Schedule a recurring task. The prompt runs automatically on the given schedule as this agent, and the reply is posted back into this chat/topic. Use for reminders, digests, periodic checks.

schedule.description: Standard 5-field cron: 'min hour day-of-month month day-of-week'. E.g. '0 9 * * *' = 09:00 daily; '*/30 * * * *' = every 30 min; '0 8 * * 1' = 08:00 every Monday.

prompt.description: The instruction to run on schedule, exactly as if the owner typed it.

tools.name: cron_list
tools.description: List all scheduled cron jobs with their id, schedule, agent, topic and prompt.

tools.name: cron_remove
tools.description: Delete a scheduled cron job by its id (from cron_list).

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read your configuration: active provider, per-provider models, and masked API keys.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Change a config value. Keys: provider (gemini/openai/anthropic/openrouter/local/claude-sdk — claude-sdk drives the Claude Agent SDK on the operator's subscription session usage, no API key); per-provider gemini_model/gemini_api_key, openai_model/openai_api_key/openai_base_url, anthropic_model/anthropic_api_key, openrouter_model/openrouter_api_key, local_model/local_base_url/local_api_key, claude_sdk_model/claude_sdk_url; brave_api_key (enables web_search).
